plain: A basic belief or principle held by a group

webster.text: Any opinion, principle, dogma or doctrine which a person believes or maintains as true; as the tenets of Plato or of Cicero.

example.quote: Let us examine this doctrine; and that we may avoid the possibility of mistating the writer, it shall be laid down in his own words: a precaution the more necessary, as scarce any thing else could outweigh the improbability, that so extravagant a tenet should be hazarded, at so early a day, in the face of the public.
example.cite: James Madison, Helvidius No. I, Aug. 24, 1793
